about: handpan-interaction.mjs scripted hands, revision 2; 90 Hz frames; positions in world metres (seat frame); frames carry no sample interval; PLACE {"centre":[0,0.74,0.38],"tiltDeg":28,"yawDeg":0}

cases.name: tap-A3
cases.desc: Right index taps A3 at the dimple edge at 0.6 m/s: one tip strike

cases.name: soft-tap-ding
cases.desc: A soft 0.15 m/s tap on the ding: one quiet strike

cases.name: too-slow
cases.desc: A finger placed at 0.05 m/s: no sound; resting 0.10 s damps; lifting releases

cases.name: hover-jitter
cases.desc: After a strike on C4 the finger hovers with +-3 mm jitter around +5 mm (under the 1 cm re-arm height): no retrigger

cases.name: repeat-6hz
cases.desc: The same finger taps E4 six times at 6 strokes/s (rises 2.5 cm between): six strikes

cases.name: two-fingers-one-hand
cases.desc: Index and middle of the right hand land on D4 22 ms apart: one strike (per-hand 40 ms window)

cases.name: two-hands-flam
cases.desc: Left and right index hit G4 11 ms apart: two strikes (a flam; the sound unit merges hits inside one contact)

cases.name: tak-between
cases.desc: A tap on the steel between A3 and C4: a tak (field 9) at its map point, with the two neighbours the unit also rings

cases.name: ding-slap
cases.desc: A flat right hand slaps the ding at 0.9 m/s: exactly one slap, no fingertip strikes

cases.name: palm-rest
cases.desc: The flat right hand settles on the ding at 0.03 m/s and rests 0.4 s: damps the ding (+ the shell), then releases on lifting

cases.name: tracking-loss
cases.desc: A finger resting on A3 (placed slowly, damping) loses tracking for 0.5 s and returns under the steel: release 0.30 s after the loss, no strike

cases.name: brush
cases.desc: A fast sideways brush across E4 (tangential 0.9 m/s, normal 0.08 m/s): no strike

cases.name: outside-rim
cases.desc: A tap beyond the rim (off the instrument): nothing

cases.name: field-edge
cases.desc: A tap at the outer edge of C5 (rho 0.95): a C5 strike with u near 1

cases.name: teleport
cases.desc: A one-frame tracking glitch throws the index 20 cm up mid-stroke on A4: the crossing still counts once (re-armed only from clean samples)

cases.name: predicted-90hz
cases.desc: F4 tapped at 0.6 m/s, a new pose every frame (Unity predicted pose): one strike (the reference for tracker-30hz)

cases.name: tracker-30hz
cases.desc: The same F4 stroke seen by a 30 Hz tracker (pose repeats for 3 frames): one strike, velocity within 0.1 of predicted-90hz

cases.name: press-0.15s
cases.desc: C4 tapped at 0.5 m/s, the pad left at -4 mm for 0.15 s, then lifted: one strike, no damp

cases.name: press-0.5s
cases.desc: C4 tapped, the pad left still at -4 mm for 0.5 s: one strike, a finger damp 0.40 s after it settled (afterStrike), release on lifting

cases.name: press-deep-0.5s
cases.desc: C4 tapped, the pad pushed 15 mm through the steel and held 0.5 s (VR has no rebound): one strike, no damp

cases.name: lift-hint
cases.desc: Three C4 taps, each held still at -3 mm for 0.45 s: three afterStrike damps and the Sunny hint tip_handpan_lift after the third

cases.name: palms-down-tap-0.3
cases.desc: A3 tapped at 0.3 m/s with the palm facing the steel, its joint 4 cm above the index tip joint: one strike at the crossing frame (delay 0)

cases.name: palms-down-tap-0.6
cases.desc: A3 tapped at 0.6 m/s with the palm facing the steel, its joint 4 cm above the index tip joint: one strike at the crossing frame (delay 0)

cases.name: palms-down-tap-1
cases.desc: A3 tapped at 1 m/s with the palm facing the steel, its joint 4 cm above the index tip joint: one strike at the crossing frame (delay 0)

cases.name: flat-slap-lag30
cases.desc: A flat hand slaps the ding at 0.4 m/s, the palm 30 mm behind the finger pads (they land 75 ms first): one slap, no fingertip strikes

cases.name: tap-A3-jitter-0.5mm
cases.desc: A3 min-jerk tap (peak 0.6 m/s) with 0.5 mm jitter: one strike

cases.name: too-slow-jitter-0.5mm
cases.desc: E4 finger lowered at 0.05 m/s with 0.5 mm jitter and left 0.5 s (a deliberate mute): the events this seed gives (rates: out/hands-acceptance.json)

cases.name: hover-6mm-jitter-0.5mm
cases.desc: Index hovering 6 mm above A3 for 2 s with 0.5 mm jitter: no strike

cases.name: tap-A3-jitter-1mm
cases.desc: A3 min-jerk tap (peak 0.6 m/s) with 1 mm jitter: one strike

cases.name: too-slow-jitter-1mm
cases.desc: E4 finger lowered at 0.05 m/s with 1 mm jitter and left 0.5 s (a deliberate mute): the events this seed gives (rates: out/hands-acceptance.json)

cases.name: hover-6mm-jitter-1mm
cases.desc: Index hovering 6 mm above A3 for 2 s with 1 mm jitter: no strike

cases.name: tap-A3-jitter-2mm
cases.desc: A3 min-jerk tap (peak 0.6 m/s) with 2 mm jitter: one strike

cases.name: too-slow-jitter-2mm
cases.desc: E4 finger lowered at 0.05 m/s with 2 mm jitter and left 0.5 s (a deliberate mute): the events this seed gives (rates: out/hands-acceptance.json)

cases.name: hover-6mm-jitter-2mm
cases.desc: Index hovering 6 mm above A3 for 2 s with 2 mm jitter: no strike
